title: Tomas's Kite for the Spring Festival

nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Tomas wakes up excited about the spring festival happening this afternoon. His grandmother Abuela is in the kitchen making breakfast. Tomas tells her about the big kite-flying contest. Abuela smiles and says they can build a kite together right now.'>>

choices.label: Start building right away
Tell Abuela they won't have enough time

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Tomas worries they won't have time to build and test. Abuela smiles and shows him special sticks and string she saved for months. She says she was waiting for the right day to build with him.'>>

choices.label: Feel hopeful and start the building

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='At the kitchen table, Tomas and Abuela sketch kite designs. Tomas suggests a big diamond kite. Abuela mentions a traditional box kite from her childhood. They could also try a simple triangular design.'>>

choices.label: Build the diamond kite
Build the box kite
Build the triangle kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=72 beats='Tomas and Abuela gather sticks and string from the garage. They cut old plastic bags and tie them to the sticks. Abuela shows Tomas how to knot the flying string carefully. The kite comes together piece by piece.'>>

choices.label: Go test the kite outside

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=73 beats='They go to the field behind Abuela's house. The morning wind is soft and gentle. Tomas holds the kite while Abuela unwinds string. Tomas releases it. The kite wobbles at first then catches the wind and climbs steadily.'>>

choices.label: The kite soars high and steady
The kite spins and crashes

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=72 beats='The kite dances in the wind and climbs higher. Tomas laughs as he holds the string steady. But then the wind suddenly shifts direction. Clouds roll across the sky. The wind becomes unpredictable and gusts hard.'>>

choices.label: Keep flying and watch how it responds
Land it and check the design

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The kite crashes to the ground. Tomas runs to pick it up. One stick is cracked badly. Abuela kneels beside him and points out where the force broke the frame. The damage is more than they can fix quickly.'>>

choices.label: The kite is too broken to fix in time
Try to repair it with stronger materials

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Tomas keeps flying as wind gusts come and go. He feels the string tug in new directions. By moving his hands, he learns how the kite responds. Each gust teaches him something about flight.'>>

choices.label: Feel confident it will fly at the festival
The wind is still too unpredictable to trust

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=71 beats='They bring the kite down and sit in the grass. Abuela traces her finger along the frame and cloth. She talks about how wind pushes differently on different parts. The kite shows real promise but needs tiny adjustments.'>>

choices.label: Make small improvements to the design
It looks good enough as is

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Abuela finds a spare stick in her craft box. She shows Tomas how to lash it to the cracked stick with strong twine. Tomas holds both sticks steady. The frame feels solid again. The repair might hold.'>>

choices.label: Quick test of the repaired kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Abuela brings tape and twine. They wrap extra bands around the corners where the kite shows stress. Tomas helps reinforce where frame meets cloth. The kite now feels much sturdier and more balanced.'>>

choices.label: Go to the festival with the improved kite

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=68 beats='Back in the field, Tomas launches the repaired kite. It climbs more smoothly than before. The wind is gentler this time. The kite floats steadier. The repair held strong. Tomas beams with hope.'>>

choices.label: Head to the festival now

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=75 beats='Tomas and Abuela arrive at the spring festival. The field fills with children flying colorful kites. The contest is starting. Tomas holds his kite proudly. He feels nervous and excited. Every lesson they learned prepares him.'>>

choices.label: Launch and the kite dances perfectly
Launch and the kite flies well
Launch but something goes wrong

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=74 beats='Tomas and Abuela look at the broken kite. The damage is too much to fix quickly. They sit down together and talk about what they tried. They built something and learned together. Sometimes things don't go as planned and that's okay.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=72 beats='Tomas and Abuela bring the kite down gently. They feel excited about how well it responded to the wind. Tomas feels confident. They decide to save the kite and try it again next spring. Building it together was the real victory.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=73 beats='The unpredictable wind worried Tomas. He and Abuela decide they're not confident enough to fly it in the contest today. They laugh knowing they built something wonderful anyway. They can try again when Tomas feels ready. That's wise.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=72 beats='Looking at the kite in the afternoon sun, Tomas felt proud. Abuela said his design showed real promise. They decided to wait and fly it when they could test it more. Building something that works is an achievement in itself.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=80 beats='Tomas's kite rises high and graceful. It stays airborne longer than most others. The judges watch carefully. When the wind shifts, the kite adapts beautifully each time. Tomas wins the blue ribbon. Abuela hugs him tight. They celebrate under the festival sun.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=78 beats='Tomas's kite flies well and stays in the air during the contest. It doesn't win first place but the judges notice it. They give special recognition for teamwork and creative effort. Tomas feels proud. Winning wasn't everything. Building mattered most.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=76 beats='The kite wobbles and falls during the contest. Tomas feels disappointed. But Abuela reminds him of everything they discovered together. They learned and worked hard. Failure taught them more than success could. Next year they'll try again.'>>
